title: Notes-file save can silently overwrite another program's change
description:
internal/store/file.go:L59-76 (Save) and L112-115 (Backup).

Problem: Save writes without checking whether the file changed on disk since our last read/write. Changes from other programs are only noticed by the 500 ms poll (CheckExternal). If another program (sync tool, other editor, second cool-notes) writes the file and our debounced save or the quit-time Flush runs before the next poll, our write replaces theirs, Save records our file as 'known', and the poll never sees a conflict. No .bak is written; their version is gone.

Related, same conflict path: Backup names files <path>.conflict-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.bak. Two conflicts in the same second write the same name, and the second overwrites the first backup.

Fix (small, stays in file.go):
1. In Save, under the lock and before writeAtomic: stat the file; if it exists and differs from f.known (same check CheckExternal uses), read it and write it via Backup first. Return the backup name (or a flag) so the UI can flash it, like applyExternal does.
2. Make the backup name unique: e.g. os.CreateTemp-style suffix or append nanoseconds / a counter when the name exists.
acceptance_criteria:
- Test in internal/store: Save(1), external os.WriteFile, Save(2) without CheckExternal in between -> a .conflict-*.bak exists holding the external content. Fails on current main.
- Test: two Backup calls within one second produce two files, both with their content.
- UI flashes the backup path when Save made one.
- go test ./internal/store ./internal/ui passes.

title: Undo after a no-op replace all undoes an unrelated earlier edit
description:
internal/ui/search.go:L286-290 (doReplaceAll), L301-312 (undoReplaceAll); internal/editor/editor.go:L83-86 (ReplaceText early return).

Problem: ReplaceText returns without pushing an undo step when the new text equals the old. Matching ignores case, so replacing 'foo' with 'foo' (or 'Foo' where the note already says 'Foo') changes nothing, yet doReplaceAll still adds the note to m.replaced. Pressing Ctrl+Z straight after then calls Undo on that note and reverts the user's previous, unrelated edit. The flash also over-counts replaced notes.

Fix: in doReplaceAll, compare t.ed.Version() before and after ReplaceText and only append to m.replaced when it changed. Two lines.
acceptance_criteria:
- Test in internal/ui/features_test.go: type 'abc', commit an edit, replace all 'abc' with 'abc', Ctrl+Z -> note text unchanged. Fails on current main.
- Existing TestReplaceAllNotesAsksAndUndoesTogether still passes.

title: Saving replaces a symlinked notes file with a regular file
description:
internal/store/file.go:L22-28 (Open) and L119-153 (writeAtomic).

Problem: writeAtomic renames a temp file over the path. If the notes path is a symlink (e.g. ~/notes.txt -> ~/Dropbox/notes.txt, common with dotfiles or sync folders), the rename replaces the link itself with a regular file. From the first save on, notes go to the local copy and the synced target stops updating, with no message.

Fix: in Open, resolve the path once with filepath.EvalSymlinks (ignore fs.ErrNotExist, keep the path as is then) and store the resolved path in File.Path. The temp file is then created next to the real file and the rename lands on it. A few lines, nothing else changes.
acceptance_criteria:
- Test in internal/store: create target file + symlink to it, Open(symlink), Save -> symlink is still a symlink (os.Lstat) and the target holds the new content. Fails on current main.
- Missing-file path (first run) still works.
- go test ./internal/store passes.

title: External-change reload can race with an in-flight save and drop our edits
description:
Pre-existing, found while reviewing 8feef1c. internal/ui/app.go (savedMsg/externalMsg handling) and internal/store/file.go (CheckExternal, Save).

Case: the user types (dirty) and another program writes the file. The CheckExternal goroutine reads their version and marks it known. Then the saveCmd goroutine writes ours (no backup, because known now matches the disk). If savedMsg is handled before externalMsg, the model is clean, so applyExternal reloads THEIR text into the editor while the file holds OURS. The next keystroke saves theirs+edit, and our text survives only in the undo history. Window: a few ms, needs typing at the same moment as an outside write.

Fix idea: have externalMsg carry the file's known stat, and drop it in applyExternal when a save finished after the check (e.g. compare a save counter captured by checkExternal with savedGen), or re-run CheckExternal instead of applying a stale result.
acceptance_criteria: Test that runs CheckExternal, then Save of new edits, delivers savedMsg and then externalMsg -> editor keeps our text, and theirs is in a .bak.

title: Config/state writes skip fsync and share one temp name; reuse the store's atomic writer
description:
internal/config/config.go:L106-120 (writeJSON) vs internal/store/file.go:L119-153 (writeAtomic).

Problem: writeJSON writes <name>.tmp without fsync and renames it. After a power loss the rename can land before the data, leaving an empty or partial config.json. config.Load then fails and main exits with 'reading config: unexpected end of JSON input', so the app will not start until the user deletes the file. The fixed .tmp name also lets two running instances write the same temp file at once.

The store package already has a correct atomic writer (unique temp name, fsync, dir sync). Two helpers do the same job.

Fix: export store.writeAtomic (e.g. store.WriteAtomic, or move it to a tiny internal/atomicfile) and call it from writeJSON. Deletes ~4 lines from config and removes the duplicate logic.
acceptance_criteria:
- writeJSON uses the shared atomic writer; no '.tmp' fixed name left (grep).
- go test ./internal/config ./internal/store passes.

title: Conflict backup made by the quit-time save is never reported
description:
internal/ui/app.go Flush and main.go run(). Since 8feef1c, Save returns a backup name. Flush (Ctrl+Q and the final save in main) discards it. If another program changed the file in the last <500 ms before quit, their version is saved to .conflict-*.bak but the user is never told. Nothing is lost.

Fix: return the backup name from Flush, and have main print 'cool-notes: file changed on disk; theirs saved to <path>' to stderr after the program exits.
acceptance_criteria: Quit right after an external write prints the backup path; unit test on Flush returning the name.

title: Merge the duplicated confirm-dialog key handling
description:
internal/ui/app.go:L614-643 (handleKey) and L761-768 (handleClick).

The modalConfirmDelete and modalConfirmReplace key switches are line-for-line copies; only the confirm action differs (closeTab(m.confirmIdx) vs doReplaceAll()). A change to dialog keys (e.g. adding a key) must be made twice and can drift.

Fix: one case 'modalConfirmDelete, modalConfirmReplace' that picks the action via a small helper confirm() used by both the key and click paths. About -14 lines.
acceptance_criteria:
- One switch handles both dialogs' keys; handleClick uses the same confirm helper.
- TestNewTabAppendsAndCloseDeletesAfterConfirm, TestTypingInConfirmDialogDoesNotEdit, TestReplaceAllNotesAsksAndUndoesTogether pass.
